headline: Olivia Rodrigo says she will never use AI in her music and calls online speculation about her dating life invasive.
score_reason: Pool 5; read in full; a direct interview with a named singer; no change.
importance_line: A major pop singer has set a firm line against AI in music, which matters most to musicians and fans, and the doubt is that this is a personal interview rather than a policy.
summary: Billboard reports, citing a cover interview in The Hollywood Reporter, that the pop singer Olivia Rodrigo said she would never use AI in her music: “Absolutely no. Hard line on that.” She is answering the online speculation that followed photos of her with a man in July, saying she is single and that being stalked and judged for those pictures is “the craziest thing.”
notes: Source chain: The Hollywood Reporter cover interview (first reporter), relayed by Billboard. THR link not in the text read, so the Billboard page is the url. The reply part: she answers the speculation that followed the July photos.
